    <dc:description><b><b>A <i>New York Times</i> bestseller!<br>&ldquo;Witty, endearing and greatly entertaining.&rdquo; <i>&mdash;Wall Street Journal</i></b><br> &#160;<br> <b>&ldquo;Don&rsquo;t trust anyone, including the four septuagenarian sleuths in Osman&rsquo;s own laugh-out-loud whodunit.&rdquo; &mdash;<i>Parade</i></b> <br>Four septuagenarians with a few tricks up their sleeves<br>A female cop with her first big case<br>A brutal murder<br>Welcome to...<br>THE THURSDAY MURDER CLUB</b><br>In a peaceful retirement village, four unlikely friends meet weekly in the Jigsaw Room to discuss unsolved crimes; together they call themselves the Thursday Murder Club. <br>When a local developer is found dead with a mysterious photograph left next to the body, the Thursday Murder Club suddenly find themselves in the middle of their first live case. <br>As the bodies begin to pile up, can our unorthodox but brilliant gang catch the killer, before it's too late?</dc:description>
